benchmark.name: Embodied Agent Interface v3 — Action Sequencing

summary.en: EAI tests one-shot household action sequencing in the VirtualHome environment.
summary.zh: EAI 测试 VirtualHome 环境中的一次性家务动作序列生成。

task_format.en: Given symbolic state, goal, actions, and rules, generate a complete action sequence for 338 instructions.
task_format.zh: 给定符号状态、目标、动作和规则，为 338 条指令生成完整动作序列。

explanation.en: A plan succeeds only when the revised MotionPlanner executes it and reaches the task goal.
explanation.zh: 只有 revised MotionPlanner 能执行计划并达到任务目标时才算成功。

benchmark.date_policy: Primary lifecycle time uses the earliest available date among evaluation/run time, model release time, and the earliest recorded score-publication time for the same observation. Plot dates and T50/T80/T90 are clipped at benchmark release, so lifecycle durations are never negative; original dates remain preserved for provenance.

test-of-time.rule: T50 >= 12 months OR T90 >= 24 months, including censoring

still-frontier.rule: right-censored T50 AND normalized progress < 50% AND coverage not low

recently-saturated.rule: T90 crossing within 3 months of snapshot
